comment: Game mode $13 (win game) text data. Bank 2 is mapped at CPU $8000, and in this ROM the bank-2 PRG offset equals the CPU address, so the offsets below are both.

thanksText.rom: ThanksText @ Z_02.asm:3257 — Zelda's line, typed by UpdateZeldaTextbox

peaceText.rom: PeaceText @ Z_02.asm:3564 — the closing line, typed by UpdatePeaceTextbox

peaceCharAddrsLo.rom: PeaceTextboxCharAddrsLo @ Z_02.asm:3556 — nametable $22xx, dropping to $23xx below $A0

creditsPagesTextMasks.rom: CreditsPagesTextMasks @ Z_02.asm:3747 — which scroll rows carry text

creditsLastScreens.rom: CreditsLastScreenList @ Z_02.asm:3672 — nametable flips before the roll stops, per quest

creditsQuestGating.comment: DrawCredits @ Z_02.asm:3838. Line index >= $17 has no text at all; quest 1 drops indices >= $10, quest 2 drops $C..$F.

playerNameLineIndexRom: DrawCredits @ Z_02.asm:3893 — line $11 is overwritten with the profile name
